# Experiment <ID>: <title>

Status: planned / implemented / run / validated / inconclusive

## Research question

State one question and measurable observables.

## Mathematical assumptions

Specify domain, units, conventions, approximations, and validity limits.

## Governing equations

Document equations, initial/boundary conditions, and supporting derivations.

## Numerical method

Record algorithm, resolution, tolerances, and stopping criteria.

## Expected behavior

State the reference prediction before running the experiment.

## Falsification criteria

Specify outcomes that would contradict the tested mechanism and distinguish
those from numerical failure or an inconclusive measurement.

## Reproduction record

Record date, Git revision and dirty state, command, configuration, environment,
random seeds, and retained artifact locations/checksums.

## Simulation results

Pending. Report measurements and uncertainty; do not substitute predictions.

## Validation tests

Pending. Report analytical comparisons, convergence, and applicable invariants.

## Conclusion

Pending. State what the evidence supports, limits of that conclusion, and next steps.
